sentences.en: The origin of the universe will probably never be explained.
sentences.zh: 宇宙的起源可能永远无法解释。

sentences.zh: 让我来告诉你这所学校的历史起源。

sentences.en: Today's trivia corner! Today it's about the origin of Calpis.
sentences.zh: 今天的趣味知识！今天的话题是Calpis的起源。
